profile.org_note: Founder-led private company with a thin corporate layer: executive chairman Wade Jurney, CEO and president Michael Bergman, COO John Hayes. No division presidents, land head or CFO are named in public sources; in Sept 2026 Bergman said he personally covers land, accounting and finance and is still deciding which leaders to add as the company scales, so land and capital decisions sit with Bergman and Jurney.
profile.summary: Private entry-level, 100% spec builder founded in October 2021 by Wade Jurney (founder of Wade Jurney Homes, sold to Century Communities) with Michael Bergman and Gregg Erickson. It closed 550 homes in 2025 (747 in 2024), is pacing for more than 800 in 2026 and targets 1,500 to 1,800 in 2027, building in small towns and exurbs across Texas, the Carolinas, Oklahoma, Indiana, Alabama, Florida and Georgia. It is a conventional for-sale builder that also sells to and fee-builds for build-to-rent investors; it buys finished lots only and openly solicits developed homesites, which makes it a plausible but small finished-lot customer for a land banker. The company site lists one office, in Houston, TX, and its May 2025 release is datelined Houston; it launched out of Atlanta, GA, and some directories still show Roswell, GA.
